comments.author: SkebbZ
comments.body_html:
I added my first draft here: https://pastebin.com/gSfKrjzL

It has progression more or less like this:

  • Ammo under 30 pen can be crafted at workbench 1
  • Ammo at around 30-40 pen can be crafted at workbench 2
  • Ammo at about 40+ can be crafted at workbench 3
  • Some of the higher tier ammo types now requires some extra tools and gunpowder

Perhaps you’ll find some inspiration there, I’ll probably keep tweaking it a bit more once I have played for a bit.

If anyone reading this would like to try it, just replace the file in \SPT\user\mods\VanillaCraftAmmo\db\CustomHideoutRecipes

comments.author: SkebbZ
comments.body_html:
Hey,

Use this website: https://db.sp-tarkov.com/search

Search for items by ID (templateID in the document) or by name. Use this to identify which bracket is which ammo type.

By using this website you can remove any brackets with gunpowder item ID in them (use search function in the document, paste the ID).

For example, removing the following:

    {
          "templateId": "590c5a7286f7747884343aea",
          "count": 1,
          "isFunctional": false,
          "isEncoded": false,
          "type": "Item"
    },

will remove a regular “kite” gunpowder from an item’s recipe requirements.

comments.author: Brin
comments.body_html:
A suggestion: Move your new ammo crafts from the Workbench to a hideout zone that normally doesn’t have any crafts (e.g. Heating/Library/Illumination/Solar power/etc.).

BSG’s hideout code isn’t great, and it gets really bogged down when the hideout zone you’re interacting with has “too many” craft options. The Workbench is the hideout zone with the most default crafts, is already laggy by default, and just gets worse as you accumulate tons of stuff in your stash–adding a ton of new crafts there just makes the underlying problems with BSG’s code even more painful.

comments.author: aerhyce
comments.body_html:
I have progressed all traders to lv4, and I still prefer crafting over buying from trader or flea. Buying just feels, I dunno, cheap to me? It’s trivial to make money in PvE so you effectively have infinite ammo. With crafting you need to actually scrounge the mats in raid (if you don’t buy those off the flea, which I don’t), which gives a better sense of actually being a singleplayer game.

The Flea in PvE Tarkov is extremely overpowered.

That said, for this mod to not feel too “OP”, maybe gate some crafts behind trader lvl on top of bench lvl? So you’d need to level them anyway to get to the good stuff.
